q1_issues.issue: The age appositive uses the invented scale symbol `age`; the instruction set mandates `old` for a post-nominal age tag ((Measure <person> old 43 year)), and a scale no word supplies is never invented.

"everyone" — an explicit universal — is encoded as a single group witness predicated as a unit, instead of the distributing rule over its members (which a seal must carry as an inner conjunct) plus a QuantifierPhrase companion.

The reified "involved" state and the "responsible" result state are emitted without their dual-emit flat halves — and, with a group bearer, without the per-member (Implication (PartOf $x <group>) ...) distribution the plural rule requires.
"his son" yields no `son` typing atom on sk_boy_1, although the kind word is stated in the text.

notes: Coreference (he -> the father, his son -> the boy), the non-factive say seal, the deictic "yesterday", the possessed-first Possession direction, and Patient for the event-noun "death"'s underlying subject are all right. The defective "They boy's" was parsed sensibly as "The boy's".
